citations.assessment: Rabbi Unya appears in the comparison between water and Torah. The full unit confirms the named occurrence.
Rabbi Unya’s interpretation counts four oaths against four generations. It is distinct from Chelbo’s adjacent enumeration.
Yudan and Unya present distinct sequences of Solomon’s changing fortunes. The digital text spells the name Onya.
